ko: 팀원들과 일정을 조율한 뒤에 회의 시간을 확정했어요.
de: Nachdem ich den Zeitplan mit dem Team abgestimmt hatte, habe ich den Besprechungstermin festgelegt.
en: After coordinating the schedule with the team, I confirmed the meeting time.
field_notes: vocabId=vocab_b1_0260; headword=조율하다; answer=조율한; topic=Arbeitskoordination & Termine; source=canonical vocab example verbatim; options=확정한|미룬|대체한; context=team schedule coordination before a meeting

ko: 회의 참석 여부를 오늘 안에 알려 주세요.
de: Bitte teilen Sie uns noch heute mit, ob Sie an der Besprechung teilnehmen können.
en: Please let us know by today whether you can attend the meeting.
field_notes: vocabId=vocab_b1_0261; headword=참석 여부; answer=참석 여부; topic=Arbeitskoordination & Termine; source=canonical vocab example verbatim; options=업무 분담|우선순위|마감일; context=same-day attendance confirmation

ko: 마감일이 가까운 업무의 우선순위를 먼저 정했어요.
de: Wir haben zuerst die Prioritäten für die Aufgaben mit naher Abgabefrist festgelegt.
en: We first set the priorities for tasks with approaching deadlines.
field_notes: vocabId=vocab_b1_0262; headword=우선순위; answer=우선순위; topic=Arbeitskoordination & Termine; source=canonical vocab example verbatim; options=참석 여부|업무 분담|회의실; context=prioritizing deadline-sensitive tasks

ko: 오후 회의를 위해 3층 회의실을 예약했어요.
de: Für die Besprechung am Nachmittag habe ich einen Raum im dritten Stock reserviert.
en: I reserved a meeting room on the third floor for the afternoon meeting.
field_notes: vocabId=vocab_b1_0263; headword=회의실; answer=회의실; topic=Arbeitskoordination & Termine; source=canonical vocab example verbatim; options=업무 분담|참석 여부|마감일; context=reserve an afternoon meeting room

ko: 담당자가 부재중이라 제가 대신 업무를 맡기로 했어요.
de: Da die zuständige Person nicht da war, habe ich die Aufgaben stellvertretend übernommen.
en: Since the person in charge was unavailable, I took over the duties temporarily.
field_notes: vocabId=vocab_b1_0264; headword=대신하다; answer=대신; topic=Arbeitskoordination & Termine; source=canonical vocab example verbatim; options=조율하기로|확정하기로|미루기로; context=temporarily cover an unavailable person

ko: 자료가 늦게 도착해서 회의 시작이 20분 지연됐어요.
de: Weil die Unterlagen spät ankamen, hat sich der Beginn der Besprechung um zwanzig Minuten verzögert.
en: Because the materials arrived late, the start of the meeting was delayed by 20 minutes.
field_notes: vocabId=vocab_b1_0265; headword=지연되다; answer=지연됐어요; topic=Arbeitskoordination & Termine; source=canonical vocab example verbatim; options=확정됐어요|대체됐어요|조율됐어요; context=meeting delay caused by late materials

ko: 회의 전에 업무 분담을 정해서 각자 맡을 일을 확인했어요.
de: Vor der Besprechung haben wir die Aufgabenverteilung festgelegt und geprüft, wer was übernimmt.
en: Before the meeting we agreed on the division of tasks and confirmed what each person would handle.
field_notes: vocabId=vocab_b1_0266; headword=업무 분담; answer=업무 분담; topic=Arbeitskoordination & Termine; source=canonical vocab example verbatim; options=참석 여부|회의실|우선순위; context=agree task allocation before meeting

ko: 이 보고서의 마감일은 다음 주 금요일이에요.
de: Die Abgabefrist für diesen Bericht ist nächsten Freitag.
en: The deadline for this report is next Friday.
field_notes: vocabId=vocab_b1_0267; headword=마감일; answer=마감일; topic=Arbeitskoordination & Termine; source=canonical vocab example verbatim; options=참석 여부|우선순위|회의실; context=report deadline date

ko: 결정이 늦어져서 회의를 다음 주로 미뤘어요.
de: Da sich die Entscheidung verzögerte, haben wir die Besprechung auf nächste Woche verschoben.
en: Because the decision was delayed, we postponed the meeting until next week.
field_notes: vocabId=vocab_b1_0268; headword=미루다; answer=미뤘어요; topic=Arbeitskoordination & Termine; source=canonical vocab example verbatim; options=확정했어요|조율했어요|대체했어요; context=postpone meeting after a delayed decision

ko: 참석 인원을 확인한 뒤에 최종 일정을 확정할게요.
de: Nachdem ich die Zahl der Teilnehmenden geprüft habe, werde ich den endgültigen Termin festlegen.
en: After checking the number of participants, I will finalize the schedule.
field_notes: vocabId=vocab_b1_0269; headword=확정하다; answer=확정할게요; topic=Arbeitskoordination & Termine; source=canonical vocab example verbatim; options=조율할게요|대체할게요|미룰게요; context=finalize schedule after attendance check

ko: 팀장님이 부재중이셔서 메일로 보고드렸어요.
de: Da die Teamleitung abwesend war, habe ich per E-Mail Bericht erstattet.
en: Since the team leader was unavailable, I sent a report by email.
field_notes: vocabId=vocab_b1_0270; headword=부재중; answer=부재중이셔서; topic=Arbeitskoordination & Termine; source=canonical vocab example verbatim; options=회의 중이셔서|출장 중이셔서|휴가 중이셔서; context=leave report by email for absent team leader

ko: 일정 변경에 협조해 주셔서 감사합니다.
de: Vielen Dank, dass Sie bei der Terminänderung mitgewirkt haben.
en: Thank you for cooperating with the schedule change.
field_notes: vocabId=vocab_b1_0271; headword=협조하다; answer=협조해; topic=Arbeitskoordination & Termine; source=canonical vocab example verbatim; options=이해해|참여해|응답해; context=thank counterpart for schedule-change cooperation

ko: 접수된 민원에 대해 담당 부서가 검토를 시작했습니다.
de: Die zuständige Abteilung hat mit der Prüfung der eingereichten Beschwerde begonnen.
en: The responsible department has begun reviewing the complaint that was filed.
field_notes: vocabId=vocab_b2_0217; headword=민원; answer=민원; topic=Formelle Beschwerde & Abhilfe; source=canonical vocab example verbatim; options=이의 제기|서면 답변|조치; context=department begins formal complaint review

ko: 제품의 결함이 확인되면 즉시 교환 절차를 안내해 드리겠습니다.
de: Wenn ein Produktmangel bestätigt wird, informieren wir Sie unverzüglich über das Umtauschverfahren.
en: If a product defect is confirmed, we will promptly explain the exchange procedure.
field_notes: vocabId=vocab_b2_0218; headword=결함; answer=결함; topic=Formelle Beschwerde & Abhilfe; source=canonical vocab example verbatim; options=오류|손상|불편; context=confirmed defect and exchange process

ko: 불편을 드린 점에 대해 적절한 보상 방안을 검토하겠습니다.
de: Wir werden angemessene Möglichkeiten der Entschädigung für die entstandenen Unannehmlichkeiten prüfen.
en: We will review appropriate compensation options for the inconvenience caused.
field_notes: vocabId=vocab_b2_0219; headword=보상; answer=보상; topic=Formelle Beschwerde & Abhilfe; source=canonical vocab example verbatim; options=처리|시정|접수; context=review compensation for inconvenience

ko: 같은 문제가 반복되지 않도록 절차상의 문제를 시정하겠습니다.
de: Wir werden die Probleme im Verfahren beheben, damit sich dasselbe Problem nicht wiederholt.
en: We will correct the procedural issues so that the same problem does not recur.
field_notes: vocabId=vocab_b2_0220; headword=시정하다; answer=시정하겠습니다; topic=Formelle Beschwerde & Abhilfe; source=canonical vocab example verbatim; options=보완하겠습니다|처리하겠습니다|접수하겠습니다; context=correct procedure to prevent recurrence

ko: 재발을 막기 위해 원인을 분석하고 개선안을 마련했습니다.
de: Um ein erneutes Auftreten zu verhindern, haben wir die Ursache analysiert und Verbesserungsmaßnahmen ausgearbeitet.
en: To prevent recurrence, we analyzed the cause and prepared improvement measures.
field_notes: vocabId=vocab_b2_0221; headword=재발; answer=재발; topic=Formelle Beschwerde & Abhilfe; source=canonical vocab example verbatim; options=결함|보상|민원; context=cause analysis and prevention plan

ko: 제출하신 이의 제기는 어제 공식적으로 접수했습니다.
de: Wir haben Ihren eingereichten Einspruch gestern offiziell entgegengenommen.
en: We officially received your submitted objection yesterday.
field_notes: vocabId=vocab_b2_0222; headword=접수하다; answer=접수했습니다; topic=Formelle Beschwerde & Abhilfe; source=canonical vocab example verbatim; options=처리했습니다|시정했습니다|보완했습니다; context=official receipt of an appeal

ko: 담당 부서에서 관련 서류를 검토한 뒤 민원을 처리할 예정입니다.
de: Die zuständige Abteilung wird die Beschwerde bearbeiten, nachdem sie die relevanten Unterlagen geprüft hat.
en: The responsible department will process the complaint after reviewing the relevant documents.
field_notes: vocabId=vocab_b2_0223; headword=처리하다; answer=처리할; topic=Formelle Beschwerde & Abhilfe; source=canonical vocab example verbatim; options=보완할|시정할|접수할; context=process complaint after document review

ko: 담당 부서에서 확인한 뒤 서면으로 답변드리겠습니다.
de: Nach Prüfung durch die zuständige Abteilung werden wir Ihnen schriftlich antworten.
en: After the responsible department has reviewed the matter, we will respond to you in writing.
field_notes: vocabId=vocab_b2_0224; headword=담당 부서; answer=담당 부서; topic=Formelle Beschwerde & Abhilfe; source=canonical vocab example verbatim; options=고객 센터|접수 창구|관리 부서; context=responsible department supplies written reply

ko: 결과에 대한 이의 제기는 안내된 기한 안에 제출해 주시기 바랍니다.
de: Bitte reichen Sie einen Einspruch gegen das Ergebnis innerhalb der angegebenen Frist ein.
en: Please submit any objection to the result within the stated deadline.
field_notes: vocabId=vocab_b2_0225; headword=이의 제기; answer=이의 제기; topic=Formelle Beschwerde & Abhilfe; source=canonical vocab example verbatim; options=서면 답변|보상 신청|결함 신고; context=appeal submission within stated deadline

ko: 검토가 끝나는 대로 서면 답변을 보내드리겠습니다.
de: Sobald die Prüfung abgeschlossen ist, senden wir Ihnen eine schriftliche Antwort.
en: As soon as the review is complete, we will send you a written response.
field_notes: vocabId=vocab_b2_0226; headword=서면 답변; answer=서면 답변; topic=Formelle Beschwerde & Abhilfe; source=canonical vocab example verbatim; options=보상 방안|처리 결과|시정 조치; context=send written response once review completes

ko: 확인된 결함에 대해 필요한 조치를 이미 취했습니다.
de: Wir haben bereits die notwendigen Maßnahmen hinsichtlich des bestätigten Mangels ergriffen.
en: We have already taken the necessary action regarding the confirmed defect.
field_notes: vocabId=vocab_b2_0227; headword=조치; answer=조치; topic=Formelle Beschwerde & Abhilfe; source=canonical vocab example verbatim; options=절차|방법|대응; context=completed corrective action for confirmed defect

ko: 누락된 내용을 보완한 뒤 다시 제출해 주시기 바랍니다.
de: Bitte ergänzen Sie die fehlenden Angaben und reichen Sie die Unterlagen anschließend erneut ein.
en: Please supplement the missing information and then submit the documents again.
field_notes: vocabId=vocab_b2_0228; headword=보완하다; answer=보완한; topic=Formelle Beschwerde & Abhilfe; source=canonical vocab example verbatim; options=접수한|처리한|검토한; context=complete missing information before resubmission
